# Marquee Raises $4M in Seed Funding

[![FinSMEs](https://secure.gravatar.com/avatar/9693e37a896f29b3764ec27c2e558735?s=96&d=mm&r=g)](https://www.finsmes.com/author/admin "FinSMEs")

[**Marquee**](https://themarquee.ai/), a NYC-based developer of an AI-powered decision layer for professional sports organizations, raised $4m in seed funding.

The round, which brought total cumulative funding to $6.5m, was led by AnD Ventures, with participation from Axel Springer, Welltech Ventures, ApeX, 97212 Ventures, and Jefferson Capital Partners.

The company intends to use the capital to accelerate its machine learning R&D, expand its global technical workforce, and establish new commercial operations and offices across the United States and the United Kingdom.

Led by Co-founders Dean Bracha, Jonathan Hazut, Dror Rosenfeld, and Tal Darchi, Marquee develops a specialized artificial intelligence software platform to act as an automated decision-support layer for executive sports management, player scouting, and team analytics.

The company’s software architecture—which is already live across more than 20 elite international clubs and athletic federations spanning the Premier League, Serie A, and Major League Soccer (MLS)—aggregates disparate performance biometrics, scouting datasets, and financial metrics to help front offices make data-driven roster choices.
